recommendation_summary: For now, the reply says to sort the existing shared list by pickup date and then by status, and to use it as the kitchen queue. It then lays out a full Odoo rollout with the partner (sales, manufacturing, inventory and a counter screen), followed by a parallel run and then a cutover. So the bounded fix comes bundled with the ERP rollout and sync now, not as a conditional later step.
note: The reply recommends the due-date sort but also endorses and sequences the Odoo rollout now, and none of the four required record labels appear.
